types.name: BANK_ACCOUNT
types.definition: A bank account or loan-account number (Kontonummer, kontonr, lånenummer), tagged when the span is the number itself.
include: Value after a Kontonummer / kontonr / lånenummer label, e.g. `1234.56.78903` or solid digits
Account number stated inline with a creditor name (`konto hos DNB, 1234.56.78903`): the number alone is the span
Redaction placeholder directly after a Kontonummer label
exclude: The identical digit shape under an Org.nr. or Fødselsnummer label: ORG_NUMBER or NATIONAL_ID (label beats shape)
An IBAN (`NO` + 2 check digits + 11 digits): IBAN; a payment-card number: CREDIT_CARD
A NOK amount, a creditor name or a debt description: FINANCIAL
A longer FINANCIAL clause that merely contains the number stays FINANCIAL, with the number nested as BANK_ACCOUNT
types.boundary: The number exactly as printed, including group separators, never the label word and never an attached creditor name (B20 label table). A number in a parenthetical is its own span (B4).

types.name: CASE_NUMBER
types.definition: A police, court or agency case or reference number: the value of saksnummer, sak nr., Vår ref or Deres ref when populated, or any number carrying a court or police authority.
include: Value after saksnummer / sak nr. / Vår ref / Deres ref (only when populated, not `-` or blank)
Number plus a following authority, whatever connects them: `2018-12345 Oslo Tingrett`, `2019/12345 ved Bergen Politistasjon`, `2010-12345, Oslo Tingrett` (B23)
Redaction placeholder after a saksnummer label
A NAV benefit case number or a Lånekassen case number
exclude: `Referanse: NNNNNN`: the agency's own intake routing, never tagged by any type
A bare 4-digit year or full calendar date used on its own: DATE_TIME
An authority that precedes the number (`dom i Stavanger Tingrett, saksnummer 2018-23456`): tag the bare number only
A court name standing alone with no number: untagged
A hospital's internal journalnummer: untagged (no v2 type)
The place name inside the authority (`Oslo` in `Oslo Tingrett`): never LOCATION
types.boundary: The whole compound string, including a date-shaped prefix, which is never additionally DATE_TIME (B13). The span extends forward to the end of a following authority name (B23). Inside a CRIMINAL or FINANCIAL clause the clause runs through the number and the number is also tagged CASE_NUMBER (nested).

types.name: CREDIT_CARD
types.definition: A payment card number, typically 16 digits solid or in groups of four, with a directly attached expiry or CVV.
include: The 16-digit number as printed, solid or grouped in fours
A directly attached expiry or CVV stays inside the span
exclude: A NOK amount charged to the card: FINANCIAL, tagged separately
A bank account or loan number: BANK_ACCOUNT
An IBAN: IBAN
types.boundary: The card number exactly as printed, never the label word; a directly attached expiry or CVV stays in the span. Label first, value as printed (B20).

types.name: CRYPTO
types.definition: A cryptocurrency wallet address or exchange account identifier tied to a named person.
include: A wallet address under a Lommebok or Krypto label
An exchange account identifier
exclude: A fiat amount or the financial outcome (`mislykket investeringsprosjekt i kryptovaluta`): FINANCIAL or ECONOMIC_STATUS by their own tests
A bank account number: BANK_ACCOUNT
types.boundary: The wallet address or account identifier alone, as printed, never the label word (B20).

types.name: DATE_OF_BIRTH
types.definition: A calendar date or year stated as a person's birth date, governed by a birth marker or label such as f., født or Fødselsdato.
include: A date or year after a birth label: `f. 12.05.1972`, `født 3. mars 1980`, `Fødselsdato: 12.04.1978`
A birth year in a name parenthetical: `Markus (f. 2005)` gives `2005` (B32)
English forms: `born 12 May 1972`, `DOB: 12.05.1972`
exclude: The fødselsnummer, even though its first six digits encode the date: NATIONAL_ID owns the whole number and no part is DATE_OF_BIRTH
Any other date about the person (conviction date, a move): DATE_TIME
types.boundary: The date exactly as printed without the label or the `f.`/`født` marker: `12.05.1972`, not `f. 12.05.1972`. A birth-date parenthetical after a named person is its own span, not absorbed into PERSON, FAMILY_RELATION or MARITAL_STATUS (B4, B32). A birth date inside a narrative clause nests as DATE_OF_BIRTH, not DATE_TIME (B13). Mutually exclusive with DATE_TIME: a birth marker or label decides.

types.name: DEVICE_ID
types.definition: A hardware or device identifier (IMEI, MAC address, serial number of a personal device) tied to a named person.
include: An IMEI
A MAC address
The serial number of a personal device
exclude: A weapon's serienummer (a manufacturer's serial): untagged (B20)
A hospital or association record number: untagged
types.boundary: The identifier alone, as printed, never the label word (B20).

types.name: DRIVER_LICENSE
types.definition: A driver's licence number (Førerkortnummer), issued by a public authority.
include: The value after a Førerkortnummer label, exactly as printed
Redaction placeholder after a Førerkortnummer label
exclude: The vehicle's registration number: LICENSE_PLATE
An 11-digit string under a Fødselsnummer label: NATIONAL_ID (label beats shape; a Førerkortnummer can also be 11 digits)
types.boundary: The number exactly as printed, never the label word. Read the label first, shape only as fallback (B20).

types.name: EMAIL
types.definition: A complete email address in local-part@domain form, exactly as printed.
include: Standard address: `anette.strand@email.com`
Norwegian-letter local parts printed verbatim: `hildegunn.sæbo@email.com`
Numbered local parts: `astrid.nilsen.1978@email.com`
A full email address used as a login
Redaction placeholder directly after an E-post label
exclude: Any string without an `@`, or a local part without its domain
A redaction placeholder after a non-email label (Telefon, Fødselsnummer): typed by that label instead
types.boundary: The full local-part@domain string only, stopping at whitespace or the next field label; never the E-post label or trailing punctuation. Never overlaps another type.

types.name: FAX_NUMBER
types.definition: A fax number under a Faks or Fax label.
include: The digits after a Faks / Fax label, same shape as a phone number
Redaction placeholder after a Faks / Fax label
exclude: A number under a Telefon / Tlf label: PHONE
types.boundary: The digits and any interior spaces or plus sign, same boundary as PHONE; never the label word.

types.name: FIREARMS_LICENSE
types.definition: A firearms card or weapon licence number issued by the police, identifying the licence holder.
include: The value after `Våpenkortnummer` / `våpenkort nr.`: `HG12345`, `W0987654`
A weapon's `Lisensnummer` or its `registreringsnummer` in the state firearms register: `registreringsnummer: AB1234` on a rifle
A permit ID for a firearm: `Permit ID: HR-2024-4321`
exclude: A weapon's `serienummer` / `våpennummer`, the manufacturer's mark on the weapon itself: untagged (B20)
A road vehicle's registration: LICENSE_PLATE
types.boundary: The number alone, as printed, never the label word or the weapon description (B20).

types.name: IBAN
types.definition: An International Bank Account Number, recognised by the IBAN label or the NO + 2 check digits + 11 digits shape.
include: The full IBAN string including country code and group spacing
A Norwegian IBAN written without a label, by shape
exclude: A Norwegian 11-digit account number under Kontonummer: BANK_ACCOUNT
A payment-card number: CREDIT_CARD
types.boundary: The full string including country code and group spacing, never the label word (B20). A longer FINANCIAL clause containing it stays FINANCIAL with the IBAN nested.

types.name: IDENTITY_CARD
types.definition: A national identity card number issued by a public authority (politiet), recognised by labels such as ID-kort and Nasjonalt ID-kort nr.
include: The value after an ID-kort or Nasjonalt ID-kort nr. label, exactly as printed
Redaction placeholder after such a label
exclude: The generic ID-nummer / Nasjonal ID-nummer label: NATIONAL_ID
A passport number: PASSPORT; a driver's licence: DRIVER_LICENSE
types.boundary: The number exactly as printed, never the label word. Typed by what it identifies and who issued it, label first (B20).

types.name: INSURANCE_NUMBER
types.definition: An insurance policy or claim number issued by a private insurer (Forsikringsnummer, Polisenummer, Skadenummer).
include: The value after a Forsikringsnummer / Polisenummer / Skadenummer label
A claim number issued by a private insurer
exclude: A NAV benefit case number: CASE_NUMBER
A medlemsnummer of a private association: untagged (B20)
types.boundary: The policy or claim number alone, as printed, never the label word (B20).

types.name: IP_ADDRESS
types.definition: An IPv4 or IPv6 address tied to a named person's device or session.
include: A dotted-quad IPv4 address
A colon-separated IPv6 address
exclude: A version number or other dotted digit string that is not an address
A URL containing a host name: URL
types.boundary: The address alone, as printed, never the label word.

types.name: LICENSE_PLATE
types.definition: A road vehicle's registration number, tagged alone as its own span.
include: The plate after registreringsnummer / reg.nr. / kjennemerke / skiltnummer on a car: `DK 45778`, `OS78945`, `BT 12345`
exclude: A rifle's registreringsnummer or Lisensnummer, or a Våpenkortnummer: FIREARMS_LICENSE; a fishing vessel's reg.nr.: VESSEL_REGISTRATION; never LICENSE_PLATE (B20)
A private serial such as a weapon's serienummer: untagged
types.boundary: The plate alone, never absorbed into the surrounding vehicle description and never extended over the label word. The registered object decides: a car's is LICENSE_PLATE (B20).

types.name: MEDICAL_LICENSE
types.definition: A healthcare professional's authorisation or licence number issued by a public health authority (HPR-nummer, Autorisasjonsnummer).
include: The value after an HPR-nummer or Autorisasjonsnummer label, exactly as printed
exclude: A hospital's internal staff ID or journalnummer: untagged (B20)
A patient record number: untagged
types.boundary: The number alone, as printed, never the label word (B20).

types.name: MILITARY_ID
types.definition: A Forsvaret (Norwegian Armed Forces) service or ID number, issued by a public authority.
include: The value after a Militært ID-nummer or Tjenestenummer label, exactly as printed
exclude: A Våpenkortnummer or a weapon's Lisensnummer: untagged, no v2 type yet (B20)
types.boundary: The service number alone, as printed, never the label word (B20).

types.name: NATIONAL_ID
types.definition: A fødselsnummer or D-nummer: an 11-digit Norwegian national identity number.
include: 11 digits, solid (`12127012345`), with one dash after digit 6 (`120378-12345`) or one space after digit 6 (`150701 44556`)
A D-nummer, same shape, trusting the label without checking the +4 day offset
Whatever follows a generic ID-nummer / Nasjonal ID-nummer label, regardless of length
Redaction placeholder after a Fødselsnummer label
exclude: An 11-digit string under a Telefon / Tlf label: PHONE (label beats shape)
A bare 6-digit date-shaped string not followed by 5 more digits
The leading 6 digits as a separate date: never DATE_TIME or DATE_OF_BIRTH
types.boundary: The full 11 digits with its single dash or space, never split off the first six, never the label word. A fødselsnummer in a parenthetical after a name is not absorbed into the name's span (B4); date-shaped digits inside it are not additionally a date (B13).

types.name: ORG_NUMBER
types.definition: Organisasjonsnummer: a 9-digit Norwegian organisation number.
include: 9 digits, solid (`987654321`) or grouped in threes (`987 654 321`)
Redaction placeholder after an Org.nr. label
exclude: The organisation name in an `Org.nr.: NNNNNNNNN (Name)` parenthetical: ORGANIZATION when the subject test holds (B19)
A 9-digit string under a Kontonummer label: BANK_ACCOUNT; under a Telefon label: PHONE
types.boundary: The 9 digits with their spaces, never the label word and never the parenthetical name (B19, B20).

types.name: PASSPORT
types.definition: A passport number, issued by the police (a public authority).
include: The value after a Passnummer or pass nr. label, exactly as printed
exclude: A national identity card number: IDENTITY_CARD
A visa or residence-permit number: VISA_NUMBER
types.boundary: The number alone, as printed, never the label word. Typed by issuer, label first (B20).

types.name: PASSWORD
types.definition: A credential string (password, PIN, access code) attributed to a named person.
include: The literal string after a Passord or PIN label
A quoted credential
exclude: A mention of `passordet sitt` with no string: not tagged
A username: USERNAME
types.boundary: The literal credential string only, never the label word.

types.name: PHONE
types.definition: A Norwegian telephone number under a Telefon, Tlf or Telefonnummer label: 8 digits, optionally grouped and optionally prefixed with a country code.
include: 8 digits solid (`97512483`) or grouped (`975 12 889`)
With a country code, with or without plus: `+47 952 83741`, `47 987 65 432`
Any digit string under a Telefon / Tlf label regardless of digit count, including 11-digit strings shaped like a fødselsnummer
Redaction placeholder after a Telefon / Tlf label
exclude: 9 digits under an Org.nr. label: ORG_NUMBER
11 digits under a Fødselsnummer label: NATIONAL_ID
A number under a Faks / Fax label: FAX_NUMBER
types.boundary: The digits plus any interior spaces and a leading plus sign or country code, stopping at the next punctuation or field label; never the label word. Disambiguated purely by field label, never by digit count.

types.name: POSTAL_CODE
types.definition: The bare 4-digit Norwegian postal code, exactly as printed.
include: The 4 digits of a Poststed field, including leading zero: `5055`, `0182`
The 4 digits inside an ADDRESS value: `8300` in `Fjellveien 12, 8300 Svolvær`, nested
exclude: The place name after the code: LOCATION as its own span
A 4-digit year: DATE_TIME
A 4-digit fragment of a case number: CASE_NUMBER
types.boundary: Exactly 4 digits, never the place name; the one documented exception to the full-clause rule, so `1234 Bygda` gives `1234`. Inside an Adresse value it nests in ADDRESS; on a standalone Poststed field it sits beside LOCATION and nothing is ADDRESS.

types.name: SOCIAL_MEDIA
types.definition: A social media handle, profile URL or platform username tied to a named person.
include: An `@handle`
A profile URL on a social platform
exclude: A bare platform name with no handle: not tagged
A login username that is not a social handle: USERNAME
A general web address: URL
types.boundary: The handle or profile URL alone, never the label word.

types.name: STUDENT_ID
types.definition: A student identification number issued by an educational institution (Studentnummer).
include: The number after a Studentnummer label, exactly as printed
exclude: A Lånekassen case number: CASE_NUMBER
A grade or enrolment fact: ACADEMIC_RECORD
types.boundary: The number alone, as printed, never the label word (B20).

types.name: TAX_ID
types.definition: A taxpayer identification number issued by Skatteetaten (a public tax authority).
include: The value after a Skatte-ID or skattenummer label, exactly as printed
exclude: A fødselsnummer under a Fødselsnummer label: NATIONAL_ID
A NOK tax amount: FINANCIAL
types.boundary: The number alone, as printed, never the label word. Typed by issuer, label first (B20).

types.name: URL
types.definition: A web address tied to a named person, organisation or piece of evidence.
include: An address starting `https://` or `www.`
exclude: A social profile URL or handle: SOCIAL_MEDIA
An email address: EMAIL
types.boundary: The URL string, stopping before trailing punctuation.

types.name: USERNAME
types.definition: A login or account username distinct from a full email address, tied to a named person.
include: The value after a Brukernavn label
exclude: A full email address used as a login: EMAIL
A social media handle: SOCIAL_MEDIA
types.boundary: The username alone, never the label word.

types.name: VESSEL_REGISTRATION
types.definition: A fishing vessel's or boat's registration mark, identifying the registered owner.
include: The mark after `reg.nr.` / `registrert som` on a fiskefartøy or fiskebåt: `ST-476`, `SF-4278`, `N54321`
exclude: The vessel's name (`"Havbris"`): ORGANIZATION if it is the subject business, otherwise untagged
A road vehicle's registration: LICENSE_PLATE
types.boundary: The mark alone, as printed, never the label word or the vessel name (B20).

types.name: VISA_NUMBER
types.definition: An immigration visa or residence-permit number issued by UDI (a public authority).
include: The value after a Visumnummer or Oppholdstillatelse nr. label, exactly as printed
exclude: The status statement around the number (`har midlertidig oppholdstillatelse`): IMMIGRATION_STATUS
A bare citizenship: NATIONALITY
types.boundary: The permit or visa number alone, as printed, never the label word. Typed by issuer, label first (B20).

types.name: ACADEMIC_RECORD
types.definition: A named person's educational credential, grade or enrolment at an institution, stated as a full clause.
include: A degree or completed programme: `fullført bachelorgrad i sykepleie ved OsloMet`
Enrolment or attendance facts: `har skulket videregående skole flere ganger`
A grade or result tied to the person
exclude: A trained occupation answering the occupation question (`utdannet sykepleier`): EMPLOYMENT (B26)
A student number: STUDENT_ID
A professional licence number: MEDICAL_LICENSE
types.boundary: Full clause in the style of B12, start at the predicate (B1), drop a leading determiner (B2), no terminal punctuation (B9).

types.name: ADDRESS
types.definition: The Norwegian street-address portion of a location: street name plus house number, with optional letter suffix and apartment or floor qualifier.
include: Street + number: `Fjellveien 12`, `Storgata 45`; with suffix `Fjellveien 12B`
With qualifier: `Fjellstien 12B, Leilighet 3`, `Strandveien 12B, 3. etasje`
Street + number + postal code and city when all inside the same Adresse value: `Fjellveien 12, 8300 Svolvær`
A self-reported address in prose: `Jeg bor på Granveien 14`, including the reporter's own address (B29)
exclude: A bare city or place name: LOCATION
An institution or business name: LOCATION when named as a place, ORGANIZATION when a subject
The value of a standalone Poststed field (`5055 Bergen`): never ADDRESS, only POSTAL_CODE + LOCATION
types.boundary: Street + number + suffix + qualifier, and a trailing postal code + city only inside the same Adresse value (longer form wins). Never swallow a separate Poststed field. Inside the span the 4 digits are also POSTAL_CODE and the city is also LOCATION (nested).

types.name: AGE
types.definition: A person's or animal's age stated in years, such as 43 år gammel or 5-årig, when not already inside another tagged clause.
include: `43 år gammel`, `36 år gammal`, `13 år` after er / var / alder, `5-årig`, `14-åringen`
A decade age: `i 80-årene` gives `80-årene`
An animal's age stated the same way: `rundt 2 år gammel` gives `2 år gammel`
exclude: An age inside another tagged clause (`to barn (10 og 14 år)`, `Emma (15)`, an AGE_INFO clause, an ANIMAL_INFO noun phrase): AGE never nests (B4)
Durations such as `sonet en fengselsstraff på 3 år`
A bare parenthetical number with no `år` outside a family clause (`Olsen (52)`)
Words with no number: `voksen`, `eldre`, `ung`
types.boundary: From the first digit through `år` and a directly following gammel / gamle / gammal; drop approximators (`ca.`, `rundt`, `omtrent`) and the copula. An age is its own AGE type, not a DATE_TIME.

types.name: ANIMAL_INFO
types.definition: The noun phrase identifying which living animals a document is about: species or breed, count, distinguishing descriptors and a pet's name, never the animal's condition.
include: Count + species: `fem sauer`, `flere katter`, `ca. 30-40 kyr`, `besetning på 114 høner`
Breed with descriptors in the same noun phrase: `voksen golden retriever tispe`, `Cavalier King Charles Spaniel`
A pet's name as its own span: `Thor`, `Luna`, `Rex` (PERSON excludes pet names)
A species noun with an attached name or breed: `hunden Rex`, `Luna, schäfer`
An itemised herd after `inkludert` as one span (B11)
exclude: The animal's condition, welfare finding or behaviour: HEALTH
Plain re-mentions that add nothing (`hunden`, `dyrene`, `den`) and generic `dyr` with no species, count or name
An owner or place phrase attached to the animal (`jakthundene til Bjørn Tore Hagen`: only `jakthundene`)
Animals as food or commodity, plants, uncertainty commentary (`usikker på antall`)
An animal's age on its own: AGE (inside the noun phrase it stays ANIMAL_INFO)
types.boundary: Count + descriptors + species or breed + `av rasen X` + attached name. Drop a leading determiner (B2: `en golden retriever` gives `golden retriever`) but keep quantifiers like `et par`. Stop at a comma opening a new fact, at an owner or place phrase and at a condition clause. Split coordinated species (`fem sauer og to geiter` is two spans) except an inkludert itemisation (B11). Mutually exclusive with HEALTH and PERSON.

types.name: DATE_TIME
types.definition: Any explicit calendar date and/or clock time as printed, standalone or attached to an event or record, other than a birth date.
include: Compact multi-date prose sharing month and year as one span: `15. og 22. september 2023`
A date or bare year inside a narrative clause (CRIMINAL, HEALTH and others), additionally tagged on the same characters (B13): `2018` in `dømt for bedrageri i 2018`
exclude: A birth date after f. / født / Fødselsdato: DATE_OF_BIRTH
A date-shaped prefix of a case number or fødselsnummer (`2018` in `2018/45678`): CASE_NUMBER or NATIONAL_ID only (B13)
Vague or relative time (`nylig`, `det siste året`), durations (`14 dager`), a person's age (AGE)
A 4-digit run under a Poststed label: POSTAL_CODE
types.boundary: Day + month + year + clock time as printed, longer form wins (`15. oktober 2023`, time included when it follows the date directly). Stop before deictic qualifiers (`17. mai i år` gives `17. mai`) and before any ID suffix.

types.name: EMPLOYMENT
types.definition: A named person's occupation, job title, professional role or business ownership position, with any employer phrase directly attached. A bare organisation name is ORGANIZATION, not EMPLOYMENT.
include: Bare role nouns: `veterinærassistent`, `lærer`, `pensjonist` / `pensjonert lærer` answering an occupation question
Coordinated titles as one clause: `eier og daglig leder`, `styreleder og daglig leder`
A role with its directly attached employer: `ansatt Bergen Slakt AS`, `eier av Larsen Sjømat AS`; the subject organisation's name is also tagged ORGANIZATION (nested)
The reporter's own occupation answer: `utdannet sykepleier`, `jobber for tiden i en dyrebutikk` (B26)
`forretningspartner`, `gårdbruker`, `arbeidsledig` / `registrert arbeidsledig`, workplace-condition statements about the subject's own business
exclude: A bare company or employer name with no role word: ORGANIZATION (B19)
Full personal names, even with a title (`Dr. Astrid Sæther`): PERSON owns the name, EMPLOYMENT only the role words
Hobby or association membership; political candidacy (`kandidat til kommunestyret`): POLITICAL
Courts and authorities named incidentally; generic or hypothetical role nouns; a bare `Nei` / `Ingen` answer
types.boundary: Tag the full coordinated title and a directly attached `av/i/ved <company>` with no clause break (a comma or `som har` ends it). Merge role and employer only when attached; split them when they state distinct facts (B12). Precedence: EMPLOYMENT > FAMILY_RELATION for forretningspartner; PERSON > EMPLOYMENT for the name; POLITICAL > EMPLOYMENT for elected-office spans.

types.name: FAMILY_RELATION
types.definition: A clause naming a kinship or intimate-partnership relationship between the data subject and another individual. A civil-status word such as gift, samboer or skilt with no kinship noun is MARITAL_STATUS.
include: Kinship nouns with their descriptive clause: `to barn (10 og 14 år)`, `sønn fra et tidligere forhold`, `deres felles barn`
A partner named by a relationship noun: `ektemannen Per Hansen`, `hennes ektemann, Lars Erik Bergquist`, `samboerforhold med Per Arne Olsen`
Relationship-ending facts: `skilsmisse`, `separasjon`
A household collective: `Familien Eriksen`
Third-party kinship identifiers: `svigerinne til Hans Petter Wiik`, `eksmannen til Raymond`
exclude: A status word with no kinship noun (`gift med Astrid Olsen Åsberg`, `samboer med Lars Olsen`): MARITAL_STATUS
A same-sex relationship (B31): SEXUAL_ORIENTATION
`eieren`, `nestlederen`, `forretningspartner` (EMPLOYMENT)
`vold i nære relasjoner`, `besøksforbud`: CRIMINAL
Non-kinship ties (`nabo`, `venn`, `kollega`): untagged
A detached age numeral: AGE; an age that is a family member's parenthetical stays inside the span (B4)
types.boundary: Span = relationship noun or phrase + any named individual + descriptive qualifier in the same clause, keeping a possessive the source has (B10). The named person is also tagged PERSON (nested), except a bare surname after `Familien`. A child's `(f. 2005)` is split out when it stands apart from the relation word, kept when the clause enumerates the children (B32). Itemisation is absorbed, a second fact is split (B11).

types.name: GENDER
types.definition: A person's stated sex or gender marker as a plain demographic field value, such as Kjønn: Mann.
include: `Mann`, `Kvinne` (or lower case) after a Kjønn label
An appositive value: `Sigrid Sandvik, kvinne`
exclude: Pronouns and gendered nouns (`hun`, `mannen`)
A disclosure of gender identity as a sensitive fact (being transgender): SEXUAL_ORIENTATION
types.boundary: The value alone, never the label word.

types.name: LOCATION
types.definition: A named place broader than a street address: country, county, municipality, city, village, district, named geographic feature, or a public institution or venue named as the place where something happened.
include: The values of the `Fylke:` and `Kommune:` fields: `Rogaland`, `Stavanger`
The place name in a Poststed field after the code: `4046 Hafrsfjord` gives POSTAL_CODE `4046` and LOCATION `Hafrsfjord`
The city inside an ADDRESS value, nested: `Industriveien 22, 4046 Hafrsfjord`
A place named in prose: `bor i Drøbak`, `flyttet fra Bergen`, `reiste til Spania`
A public institution or venue used as a place: `innlagt på Haukeland universitetssykehus` (nests inside the HEALTH clause), `Stavanger politistasjon`, `asylmottaket i Hobøl`
exclude: A place name inside an organisation's or authority's own name: `Oslo` in `Oslo tingrett` or `2018-12345 Oslo Tingrett`, `Fredrikstad` in `Fredrikstad Sjømat AS`, `Stavanger` in `Stavanger kommune` as the authority
A subject organisation that is also a place (a farm or school, `Mo Gård`): ORGANIZATION
An authority acting as an authority (`Mattilsynet`, `politiet`): untagged
A country stated as citizenship or origin: NATIONALITY
Generic unnamed places (`gården`, `skogen bak huset`) and placeholder values (`Fylke: Ukjent`)
A street address: ADDRESS; a postal code: POSTAL_CODE
types.boundary: The place name alone as printed, without the preposition (`Drøbak`, not `i Drøbak`); keep multi-word names whole (`Leirvik i Sogn`); one span per place. Rule: a place name inside an organisation's or authority's own name is not LOCATION, while a city inside an ADDRESS value is LOCATION (nested), and so are Poststed, Fylke and Kommune place names. ORGANIZATION > LOCATION and NATIONALITY > LOCATION on the same characters.

types.name: MARITAL_STATUS
types.definition: A person's civil status (gift, ugift, samboer, skilt, separert, enke, forlovet, registrert partnerskap), with any partner named in the same clause.
include: A status word: `gift`, `ugift`, `samboer`, `skilt`, `separert`, `enke`, `enkemann`, `forlovet`, `registrert partnerskap`
With the partner named in the same clause: `gift med Astrid Olsen Åsberg`, `samboer med Lars Olsen`, `skilt fra sin tidligere ektefelle`
The value of a Sivilstand field
exclude: A clause built around a kinship noun (`barn`, `sønn`, `mor`, `svoger`): FAMILY_RELATION, even if a status word also appears
A spouse or partner noun with no status word (`ektemannen Per Hansen`, `kona`, `kjæresten`, `eks-partner`): FAMILY_RELATION
`skilsmisse`, `separasjon`: FAMILY_RELATION
A same-sex relationship: SEXUAL_ORIENTATION (B31)
types.boundary: Status word + any partner named in the same clause; the partner is also tagged PERSON (nested). The lexical test decides: a status word and no kinship noun is MARITAL_STATUS, otherwise FAMILY_RELATION. A birth-date or fødselsnummer parenthetical after the partner is not absorbed (B4).

types.name: NATIONALITY
types.definition: A person's stated country of citizenship or national origin.
include: `norsk statsborger`, `svensk statsborgerskap`, `polsk`, `opprinnelig fra Eritrea`
The value under a Statsborgerskap label, tagged alone (`norsk`)
exclude: Ethnic or racial origin framed as heritage: ETHNICITY
Residence or asylum status: IMMIGRATION_STATUS; the permit number: VISA_NUMBER
A country that is just a place: LOCATION
types.boundary: The nationality adjective or the origin phrase, dropping the copula (`er polsk` gives `polsk`). NATIONALITY > LOCATION for a country stated as citizenship or origin.

types.name: ORGANIZATION
types.definition: The name of an organisation that is a subject of the document: the entity under inspection or reported on, or the workplace of a named person who is themselves a subject.
include: The value of `Navn på dyreeier eller virksomhet:` or `Navn på virksomhet:` when it names an organisation (`Fisk & Fryd AS`)
The organisation in an `Org.nr.: NNNNNNNNN (Name)` parenthetical
A subject organisation's name in prose, nested inside an EMPLOYMENT, FINANCIAL or CRIMINAL clause when it occurs there (`daglig leder og eier av Larsen Sjømat AS`)
A congregation, school or farm in that subject slot, treated like a company: `Stavanger Menighetssenter`, `Mo Gård`
exclude: An organisation appearing only incidentally: the reporter's own employer, a neighbour's workplace
A bank or creditor named as financial counterparty: FINANCIAL
Authorities acting as authorities: `Mattilsynet`, `politiet`, `NAV`, `Oslo tingrett`
A placeholder: `Privatperson`, `Ukjent`, `N/A`
A political party (POLITICAL), a union (TRADE_UNION), a religious community named as a belief (RELIGIOUS_BELIEF)
types.boundary: The organisation's name alone as printed, including legal suffix (`AS`, `ASA`, `SA`) and quotation marks that are part of the name; drop a generic leading noun the source separates (`virksomheten Fisk & Fryd AS` gives `Fisk & Fryd AS`). ORGANIZATION > LOCATION on the same characters; a place name inside the organisation's name is not LOCATION.

types.name: PERSON
types.definition: The complete referring expression for one identifiable, named human being: given name(s) plus surname, with any honorific directly prefixed.
include: Full name, with middle names: `Per Arne Olsen`, `Liv Kristin Haugen`
A directly prefixed honorific, no comma: `Dr. Hans Petter Hansen`, `Fru Berglund`, `Herr Hansen`, `Mr. Olsen`
A shortened form of an already tagged name, as its own span: `Lars Olsen` after `Lars Magnus Olsen` (B30)
A single given name or initial + surname when context identifies a human: `R. Lothbrok`, a first-name-only signer
A redaction placeholder standing in for a name: `[Name Redacted]` (B8)
exclude: Pet names (`Rex`, `Luna`, `Thor`): ANIMAL_INFO
A role appositive set off by a comma (`Senterets leder,`): only the name is PERSON
A bare surname alone after the full name was tagged (`Halvorsen`), and a bare surname after `Familien` (`Familien Eriksen`)
The genitive `-s`: `Fru Hansens` gives `Fru Hansen` (B21)
types.boundary: Title (if directly adjacent) + full given name(s) + surname, nothing more. Stop before a comma, parenthesis or role description, and do not run across `og` into a second person. The name is also tagged PERSON (nested) inside FAMILY_RELATION, MARITAL_STATUS and SEXUAL_ORIENTATION clauses. PERSON > EMPLOYMENT for the name in a `Dr. <Name>` construction.

types.name: AGE_INFO
types.definition: A clause where a person's age is itself the sensitive fact: vulnerability or capacity tied to age, such as being a minor or elderly, beyond a bare age numeral.
include: Vulnerability tied to minority: `mindreårig og derfor særlig sårbar`
Capacity tied to age: `er i 80-årene og klarer ikke lenger å ta vare på dyrene`
exclude: A bare age with no vulnerability framing: AGE
An age that is a family member's parenthetical: stays in FAMILY_RELATION
types.boundary: Full clause (B1, B17: keep a subject that carries the fact). The clause absorbs its own age; AGE never nests inside it.

types.name: BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN
types.definition: A clause describing a recurring or characteristic pattern of conduct performed by an identified natural person, never an animal's own conduct.
include: Owner or subject conduct with an explicit human actor: `Har sett eieren bli sint på hunden ved flere anledninger`, `Frank Olsen oppføre seg uberegnelig`
Recurring conduct toward people or animals: `rope på hunden aggressivt flere ganger`, `kaste tomflasker og stein etter hundene`
Non-cooperation or evasiveness with authorities stated as a pattern
Intoxication conduct with no clinical term and no offence: `beruset ved flere anledninger` (B22)
exclude: A span whose grammatical subject is an animal (`Hunden bjeffer ofte`, `Schæferen virker undervektig`): HEALTH or untagged
The reporter's or witness's own routine (`Jeg går tur forbi eiendommen regelmessig`)
Conduct framed in legal-process language or a named offence: CRIMINAL; `fyllekjøring`: CRIMINAL
A dependency noun (`rusmisbruk`, `alkoholproblem`): HEALTH (B22)
A stated opinion or belief: POLITICAL; a stated financial outcome (`spillegjeld`): ECONOMIC_STATUS
Bare adjectives with no actor or pattern marker (`aggressiv`)
types.boundary: The one documented exception to B1: the span keeps its subject, starting at the earliest word that establishes who performs the pattern, keeping a witnessing lead-in when it is the only actor marker (B18). Drop the outer reporting wrapper when a named subject and verb already carry the actor. Include manner, frequency, target and trigger qualifiers.

types.name: BIOMETRIC_DATA
types.definition: A clause disclosing biometric data used or intended for unique identification of a natural person, such as a fingerprint, facial or iris scan, or voice pattern used as an identification method.
include: `avga fingeravtrykk`, `identifisert ved hjelp av ansiktsgjenkjenning`
`DNA-profil registrert i politiets register` when used as an identification method
exclude: A physical description (`lys hud, mørkt hår`)
Photographs and video: not tagged, IDENTIFIABLE_IMAGE remains cut
A genetic test result or hereditary condition: GENETIC_DATA
types.boundary: Clause boundary: start at the predicate (B1), drop a leading determiner (B2), no terminal punctuation (B9).

types.name: CRIMINAL
types.definition: A clause naming a conviction, sentence, criminal charge, formal accusation, police report or investigator-stated suspicion of a specific offence, attributed to an identified or identifiable person. A bare offence noun is sufficient.
include: Convictions and sentences: `Dømt for vold i 2010`, `domfellelse for bedrageri i 2018`
Charges, reports and accusations: `anmeldt for trusler med kniv`, `politianmeldelse mot Olsen for trusler og ulovlig besittelse av et våpen`
Investigator suspicion: `mistanke om skatteunndragelse`; illegal possession: `ulovlig våpenbesittelse`
Bare offence nouns, financial offences included: `fyllekjøring`, `skattesvindel`, `forfalskning av skattedokumenter`, `hvitvasking av penger`
Concealment of income by asserted intent, without a listed noun (B28); a relationship with a minor (B24); a threat against a named victim as a specific incident
The attached case or docket reference, kept inside the span and also tagged CASE_NUMBER (nested)
exclude: A case number or court name alone with no accusation or conviction clause: CASE_NUMBER only
Lawful registered possession (`eier en registrert rifle`)
An amount or debt with no offence word: FINANCIAL or ECONOMIC_STATUS
Conduct with no legal-process language and no named offence: BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN
A dependency noun (`rusmisbruk`, even hedged): HEALTH (B22); a discrepancy that may be error (`uoverensstemmelser i regnskapet`): FINANCIAL or untagged (B28)
An allegation with no identifiable data subject (placeholder owner and placeholder address): untagged (B25); an organisation's conduct with no named principal: untagged (B16)
A refusal to disclose: untagged (B7)
types.boundary: Optional conviction or accusation verb + offence noun phrase with its object or victim + trailing time qualifier + any attached case reference, kept inside the span (the number is also CASE_NUMBER, nested). Start at the predicate (B1); a case outcome after a comma or conjunction is its own CRIMINAL span (B3); two distinct criminal facts are two spans (B11); a year inside is also DATE_TIME (B13). Precedence: CRIMINAL > FINANCIAL > ECONOMIC_STATUS, CRIMINAL > FAMILY_RELATION and CRIMINAL > SEXUAL_ORIENTATION.

types.name: DISABILITY
types.definition: A clause stating or strongly implying a physical, sensory or cognitive disability of a named person.
include: A named impairment tied to the person: `bevegelseshemmet etter en ulykke`, `sitter i rullestol`, `synshemmet`, `utviklingshemmet`, `har cerebral parese`
A functional limitation stated as the disclosed fact, keeping a nominalised subject (B17): `nedsatt hørsel på begge ører`
exclude: An animal's lameness or impairment (`halter på høyre bakbein`): HEALTH
A disease or diagnosis not framed as disability (`kronisk depresjon`, `diabetes`): HEALTH
A bare accommodation noun (`tilrettelagt arbeidsplass`): untagged
A disability benefit stated as income (`mottar uføretrygd på 18 000 kr i måneden`): FINANCIAL
types.boundary: Same boundary as HEALTH (a): affliction verb or phrase + condition, stopping at a conjunction that introduces a second fact (B1, B17). The specific type wins over HEALTH for a named person.

types.name: ECONOMIC_STATUS
types.definition: A subjective, evaluative characterization of a person's or organization's overall financial condition, with no attached number, account, creditor or named debt instrument.
include: Hedged hardship judgements: `sliter økonomisk`, `dårlig økonomi`, `begrensede økonomiske midler`, `økonomisk ustabil situasjon`
Wealth judgements: `tilsynelatende høy inntekt`
Circumstantial descriptions with no figure: `vansker med å få endene til å møtes`, `bekymret for eierens økonomiske situasjon`
Income-status judgements: `mistet jobben og sliter nå økonomisk` (the hardship clause; the job-loss clause is EMPLOYMENT)
A hardship judgement with its attached consequence as one span: `sliter økonomisk og ikke har råd til for til sauene` (B14)
exclude: Any span with a NOK or kr amount, a named creditor or a named instrument, and bare `gjeld`: FINANCIAL
A span whose head word names an offence (`skatteunndragelse`, `svindel`): CRIMINAL
A standalone affordability clause for a welfare need (`ikke har råd til dyrlege`): HEALTH (B14)
A pure occupational statement (`er pensjonist`): EMPLOYMENT
A habit (`spilleavhengighet`): BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN; a refusal to disclose: untagged (B7)
types.boundary: The complete evaluative clause including its stated consequence; where the subject is the fact, keep the noun phrase (`Lothbroks økonomiske situasjon er svært anstrengt`, B27); otherwise drop the subject (B1). Lowest in the chain CRIMINAL > FINANCIAL > ECONOMIC_STATUS; a financial outcome like `spillegjeld` is ECONOMIC_STATUS.

types.name: ETHNICITY
types.definition: A clause disclosing a named person's racial or ethnic origin, stated neutrally in bureaucratic register.
include: `identifiserer seg som same`, `har romani bakgrunn`
exclude: A citizenship with no ethnic framing: NATIONALITY
A physical description given to identify someone (`lys hud, mørkt hår`): untagged
types.boundary: Clause boundary: start at the predicate (B1), drop a leading determiner (B2), no terminal punctuation (B9).

types.name: FINANCIAL
types.definition: A concrete, verifiable financial fact: a specific amount, a named creditor or bank, or a specific named debt instrument. A span that is itself an account, card or wallet identifier takes the identifier type instead.
include: Any NOK or currency amount with its qualifier: `over 500 000 NOK`, `1,5 millioner NOK`
A named creditor or bank attached to a debt or account: `DNB`, `Santander`, `Lindorff`
A disability benefit stated as income: `mottar uføretrygd på 18 000 kr i måneden`
A discrepancy that may be error: `uriktige opplysninger i skattemeldinger` (B28)
A named debt instrument even without a number: `misligholdte lån`, `ubetalte fakturaer`, `inkassosaker`
A bare financial noun with no evaluative wrapper (`gjeld`, `utestående lån`), by tie-break default
An amount span keeps its noun and parenthetical: `betydelig gjeld (over 500.000 NOK)` (B4)
`gjeld på over 700 000 NOK, inkludert ubetalt skatt på 150 000 NOK` as one span; a separate distinct fact is its own span (B11)
exclude: Evaluative judgement with no number or instrument (`sliter økonomisk`): ECONOMIC_STATUS
A span naming an offence (`skatteunndragelse`, `forsøk på skattesvindel`) or asserting intent to conceal income: CRIMINAL (B28)
A span that is itself an account, card, IBAN or wallet identifier: the identifier type; a case number inside the clause nests
An employer name with no financial content: ORGANIZATION (B19); a bank named only as a creditor stays FINANCIAL
A refusal to disclose finances (`nektet å oppgi informasjon om sin økonomiske situasjon`): untagged (B7)
types.boundary: The complete quantified clause: amount + qualifier (`over`, `estimert til`) + debt type or creditor phrase + an `inkludert` itemisation (B11); never truncate to the bare number or noun when a qualifier attaches. Chain CRIMINAL > FINANCIAL > ECONOMIC_STATUS; an amount in the same sentence as an offence is its own FINANCIAL span. FINANCIAL beats an identifier type for a monetary amount.

types.name: GENETIC_DATA
types.definition: A clause disclosing genetic data about a named person: a genetic test or its result, or a hereditary condition confirmed by genetic testing.
include: `DNA-test bekreftet farskap`, `genetisk test viste disposisjon for brystkreft`
exclude: A diagnosis with no genetic test named: HEALTH
A DNA profile used as an identification method: BIOMETRIC_DATA
types.boundary: Full clause, start at the predicate (B1); a date inside nests as DATE_TIME (B13).

types.name: HEALTH
types.definition: A clause stating or strongly implying a medical condition, diagnosis, symptom or treatment of a human or, in the animal-welfare setting, of an animal. A named person's disability is DISABILITY and a named person's medication is MEDICATION.
include: Named diagnoses of a human: `diagnostisert med diabetes type 2`, `kronisk depresjon`, `diagnosekode F32.9`
Substance dependency framed as a condition: `rusmisbruk`, `alkoholproblem`, `alkoholpåvirket tilstand`, even hedged (B22)
Hospitalisation and mental-health facts: `innlagt på Bærum sykehus`, `ustabil mental helse`
All animal condition, symptom and medication: `halter litt`, `betente sår`, `bovine tuberkulose`
A deprived basic welfare need, even phrased about the enclosure (B14), and an incriminating negation (B15): `ingen beskyttelse mot vær og vind`, `ikke får den nødvendige veterinærbehandlingen`
Inability to afford a welfare need as a standalone clause: `ikke har råd til dyrlege` (B14)
exclude: A named person's medication: MEDICATION; a named person's disability: DISABILITY
Premises structure or cleanliness (`Burene er skitne`); enclosure size alone (`overfylte bur`): untagged (B14)
A reassuring negative finding (`ingen synlige skader`): untagged (B15)
Human conduct with no clinical term (`aggressiv atferd`), gambling habit: BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN; an offence (`fyllekjøring`): CRIMINAL (B22)
A plain kinship noun (`barn`): FAMILY_RELATION; a vague `helse` alone: untagged
types.boundary: (a) Diagnoses: affliction verb + condition, split at a conjunction (two conditions are two spans, B11). (b) Medication: usage verb + drug name, split from the purpose clause. (c) Symptoms: full noun phrase with intensifiers and body-part qualifiers. (d) Hedges (`mistanke om rabies`) are part of the clause. Start at the predicate (B1); keep a subject that carries the fact (B17); a date nests as DATE_TIME (B13).

types.name: IMMIGRATION_STATUS
types.definition: A clause disclosing a named person's immigration, residence or asylum status.
include: `har midlertidig oppholdstillatelse`, `søker om asyl`, `er statsløs`, `har fått avslag på asylsøknaden`
exclude: The permit number itself: VISA_NUMBER
A bare citizenship: NATIONALITY
types.boundary: Clause boundary: start at the predicate (B1), drop a leading determiner (B2), no terminal punctuation (B9).

types.name: MEDICATION
types.definition: A medication or treatment tied to a named person, as its own fact distinct from the diagnosis it treats.
include: Usage verb + drug: `bruker antidepressiva`, `behandles med antidepressiva`, `tar Metformin daglig`, `står på sterke smertestillende`, `bruk av reseptbelagte medisiner`
exclude: An animal's medication (`hunden får smertestillende`): HEALTH
A diagnosis: HEALTH; `Metformin for diabetes type 2` is split into `tar Metformin` (MEDICATION) and `diabetes type 2` (HEALTH)
A treatment verb with no drug noun (`er under behandling`): HEALTH
types.boundary: Usage or treatment verb + medication name + directly attached frequency or dose, stopped before a purpose clause naming the condition (HEALTH boundary (b)). Needs a drug noun.

types.name: POLITICAL
types.definition: A clause stating that an identified person holds, has stated, or is affiliated with a political party, movement or opinion, including the affiliation verb and the organisation's name.
include: Membership with verb and name: `medlem av Fremskrittspartiet`, `aktivt medlem av det høyreekstreme politiske partiet 'Norges Renhet'`
Stated political opinions: `sterke anti-EU holdninger`, `anti-immigrant holdninger`
Participation: `deltatt i demonstrasjoner mot innvandring`
The value of a Politisk tilhørighet field
exclude: A bare party or organisation name with no affiliation verb (`Norges Renhet` alone)
Religious affiliation (`Jehovas Vitner`, `Human-Etisk Forbund`): RELIGIOUS_BELIEF, never POLITICAL
A religious word inside a party name (`Kristent Folkeparti`) says nothing about belief: the clause stays POLITICAL
`lokal politiker` alone: EMPLOYMENT; `aktiv i lokalpolitikken` with no party named; `skandale` alone
A union: TRADE_UNION
types.boundary: Affiliation or opinion verb + full name including quotation marks truly present + ideological descriptor; always pull the verb in, preserve case and quotes exactly. A criminal consequence or an action taken because of the belief is a separate adjacent span. POLITICAL > EMPLOYMENT for candidacy spans.

types.name: RELIGIOUS_BELIEF
types.definition: A clause stating that a named person holds, professes, has converted to or is affiliated with a religious or philosophical belief or religious community, including non-belief such as atheism.
include: Membership: `medlem av Den norske kirke`, `medlem av Jehovas Vitner`, `aktiv i menigheten`
Professed belief or its absence, bare noun included: `er ateist`, `praktiserende katolikk`, `agnostiker`
Conversion: `konvertitt til Islam`, `konvertert fra islam til kristendommen`
Observance as personal practice: `bærer hijab av religiøse grunner`, `deltar i gudstjeneste hver uke`
The value of a Religiøs tilhørighet field
exclude: A religious body named as employer or inspected entity (`Org.nr.: 987654321 (Stavanger Menighetssenter)`): ORGANIZATION (B19)
A religious word inside a party name (`Kristent Folkeparti`): POLITICAL
Generic religious adjectives with no believer (`religiøse aktiviteter`)
A bare organisation name with no person attached (`Den norske kirke` in a list of institutions)
types.boundary: Affiliation verb + name of the belief or body, start at the predicate (B1), no terminal punctuation (B9). Atheism is RELIGIOUS_BELIEF, never SEXUAL_ORIENTATION or POLITICAL.

types.name: SEXUAL_ORIENTATION
types.definition: A clause stating, disclosing or credibly alleging a named individual's sexual orientation, gender identity or a fact about their sex life, whether self-reported, recorded or only alleged by a third party.
include: Self-identifiers with modifiers: `homofil`, `lesbisk`, `biseksuell`, `åpent homofil`, `Openly lesbian`
Noun disclosures: `seksuell legning`, `homofile legning`, `homofili`
Orientation-revealing relationships: `homofilt forhold til Lars Olsen`, `lesbisk forhold`
A same-sex relationship even without an orientation word, judged by the partner's gender against the subject's (B31)
Consensual non-monogamy: `polyamorøst forhold med to partnere`, `lever i et åpent forhold`
A third-party allegation: from `rykter om hans homofile legning` tag `hans homofile legning`
exclude: Relationship-status nouns with no orientation word (`samboer`, `ektemann`): FAMILY_RELATION; civil-status words (`gift`, `skilt`, `registrert partnerskap`): MARITAL_STATUS
A relationship with a minor and `seksuell trakassering`: CRIMINAL (B24)
A refusal to disclose (`nektet å oppgi sin seksuelle orientering`): untagged (B7)
Affair language with no orientation content (`utroskap`): FAMILY_RELATION
`ateist`: RELIGIOUS_BELIEF; `mannlig kollega` alone: untagged
types.boundary: Include leading adverbs and trailing nouns of the same noun phrase (`åpent homofil`, `lesbisk forhold`); cut reporting verbs outside it (`identifiserer seg som homofil` gives `homofil`). When a relationship noun and an orientation word share a clause, the whole clause is SEXUAL_ORIENTATION and a named partner is also PERSON (nested). SEXUAL_ORIENTATION > FAMILY_RELATION and > MARITAL_STATUS; CRIMINAL > SEXUAL_ORIENTATION.

types.name: TRADE_UNION
types.definition: A clause disclosing a named person's trade union membership or union activity.
include: `medlem av Fellesforbundet`, `tillitsvalgt i Fagforbundet`, `deltok i streiken`
exclude: A case number containing `LO`: never TRADE_UNION
A plain workplace fact: EMPLOYMENT
A political party: POLITICAL
types.boundary: Full clause with the affiliation verb and union name, per POLITICAL's boundary rule (B1, B2, B9).

legacy_map_note: Gold and slice have been migrated to v2 names (commit 87cfb30; data/gold_v2/, data/slice_v2/), so scoring against gold_v2 uses the v2 type names directly. legacy_map and each type's legacy_type are kept only for tools that emit the 17 legacy names (the old detector), mapping a v2 type to the legacy name it was scored under.
